description: Configuration file for the cleanup orchestrator. Controls thresholds, safety checks, execution behavior, and file exclusions.

thresholds.$comment: Coverage thresholds for categorizing files. Files are categorized based on their coverage percentage.
thresholds.$unused_description: Files with 0% coverage are considered completely unused (highest priority for removal)
thresholds.$lowUsage_description: Files with <30% coverage are considered low usage (candidates for refactoring or partial cleanup)
thresholds.$moderate_description: Files with 30-60% coverage are considered moderate usage (may need review)

safety.$comment: Safety verification rules to prevent accidental removal of important code
safety.$requireZeroReferences_description: If true, only remove files with no import/require references in the codebase
safety.$checkDynamicUsage_description: If true, check for dynamic imports (import(), require with variables) before removal
safety.$checkPublicAPI_description: If true, check if file is part of public API (has exports, in package.json) before removal
safety.$minDaysSinceModified_description: Minimum days since last git commit before considering file for removal (prevents removing recently modified code)

execution.$comment: Execution behavior settings that control how the cleanup process runs
execution.$dryRun_description: If true, preview changes without actually deleting files (safe mode for testing)
execution.$stopOnTestFailure_description: If true, stop the cleanup process if tests fail after a removal (recommended for safety)
execution.$maxItemsPerRun_description: Maximum number of items to process in a single cleanup run (prevents overly aggressive cleanup)
execution.$createBackupBranch_description: If true, create a git branch before making any changes (allows easy rollback)

exclusions.$comment: Files and patterns to exclude from cleanup analysis and removal
exclusions.$paths_description: Specific paths to exclude (supports glob patterns with ** for recursive matching)
exclusions.$patterns_description: File name patterns to exclude (e.g., all index.js files, all config files)
